Chapter 1: The Sinking Tower

Once every twenty years, on the anniversary of Magdala's death, the drowned tower her grieving brother Kamandur built rises from the sea for just two hours, its ghostly green light still luring ships onto the rocks. The adventurers row out to plunder it and claim the emerald at its peak. At the foot of the tower a one-eyed old man offers an elixir of life in exchange for that gem; he is really Krakul, the lindworm whose eye Kamandur stole. Seven floors of sibling-themed puzzles stand between the heroes and the top: a monster eel in the flooded cellar, a shushing librarian's ghost, skeleton guards over trapped chests, a shrunken giant spider, enchanted figureheads, and finally the twin stones in the observatory. Take the right stone, deal with Krakul, score points, and get out before the tower sinks.
